item.title: Radio System Maintenance
item.description:
Columbus Public Safety Communications and Technology
Radio System Maintenance

Dear Public Safety and Technology Subscriber,

This notification is to make users aware that maintenance is to be performed on the radio system.  

Maintenance Window: From: 02/22/2023 12:00 AM To: 02/22/2023 6:00 AM

Affected Zone(s): All Zones (1 through 4)

Expected Impact Severity: 2 - Minimal Service Interruption (20 seconds or less)

Impact Region or Sites: Tower sites and Dispatch Consoles across all 4 zones

Reason for Maintenance: Applying updates to system and zone level Virtual Machines at all 4 Master Sites. It is also recommended not to reboot any consoles during this maintenance window.  Additionally as part of this maintenance there will be one zone controller roll from the active zone controller to the standby zone controller. Subscriber units/consoles will experience a “site-trunking” event for a period of up to two (2) minutes; however it is not expected to exceed 30 seconds during the rollovers. Both consoles and radios will show "Site Trunking." As long as that is displayed consoles will not transmit to or receive from radios in the field. It is advised for dispatch centers to have back up radios ready or utilize back up resource on the console. Again, this should last for two very short periods of time as zone controllers are switched from primary to backup and then back again.

 

If you have issues or concerns outside of these dates or times please contact us at our numbers below.

item.title: Radio System Upgrade Maintenance
item.description:
Columbus Public Safety Communications and Technology
Radio System Upgrade Maintenance

Dear Public Safety and Technology Subscriber,

Maintenance Window: From: 5/9/2022 8:00 AM To: 6/10/2022 4:30 PM

Reason for Maintenance: System upgrade from version 2019.2 to 2021.1

Affected Zone(s): ALL Zones, 1 through 4

Expected Impact Severity: 1 - High -( Highest level during Zone Controller Roll portion )

Impact Region or Sites: All zones will be affected as the system is being upgraded. The system upgrade is scheduled to begin on Monday May 9th 2022. This upgrade will be performed 2 zones at a time : Zones 1 taking place the weeks of May 9th-13th and May 16th-20th.   We ask that users NOT reboot consoles during this time period unless instructed to do so. There should not be any expected widespread outages during this upgrade and everything possible will be done to limit impact to the end users. There will however be two days with scheduled zone controller rolls which will cause consoles to show red X's on their resources and mobile and portable radios to go into site trunking for a period no longer than 2 minutes. The zone controller rolls are scheduled for May 10th at 1:30PM and May 11th at 11:00AM. It is recommended that dispatchers resort to their dispatch center procedures and practices for planned radio outages during these times. 
   
   
   
   

If you have issues or concerns outside of these dates or times please contact us at our numbers below.
